title_options: Fired For A 'Non-Essential' License, I Watched Their Audit Collapse
They Called My Certification Optional. The Auditors Didn't.
My Boss Cut The One Role The Contract Required
hook: They scraped my name off the office door before I'd even made it back from the parking lot. Three weeks later, they needed that name on a federal form, and nobody else in the building was allowed to sign it.

chapters.title: The Cost Review
chapters.summary: Ryan, the only licensed compliance engineer at a logistics firm, is cut in a cost review by a new VP who calls his license non-essential.

chapters.title: The Handover
chapters.summary: Ryan hands over everything by the book, documents every open obligation in writing, and gets a signed receipt from HR.

chapters.title: Audit Season
chapters.summary: The annual safety audit arrives; the auditor asks for the licensed engineer of record, and the VP realizes nobody can sign.

chapters.title: The Invoice
chapters.summary: The firm begs Ryan to come back; he returns as an outside consultant at four times the rate, and the VP's decision lands on his own review.

description: A compliance engineer gets cut to save a line item. The line item turns out to be load-bearing.
